data.name: Yashodhan
data.gender_notes: Yashodhan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Yashodhan is recorded with the meaning “God's gift”. Yashodhan is a Hindu name meaning “God's gift”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. in_sanskrit.name: यशोधन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who possesses wealth or power.

in_hindi.name: यशोधन
in_hindi.meaning: यश (यश: यशस्वी, यश: विजयी, यश: शक्तिपूर्ण) + धन (धन: पूर्ववर्तिक, धन: धनी)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is full of power, prosperity, or wealth.

in_tamil.name: யாஷோதன
in_tamil.meaning: யாஷ் (அவ்வர் கடவுள், விஜயம், ஶகதி) + தன் (அவ்வர் தமிழ், அவ்வர் அளவம்)
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has power, prosperity, or wealth within himself.

in_telugu.name: యశోధన
in_telugu.meaning: యశ్ (యశశ్శేశ్, యశదేశ, శక్తి) + ధన్ (ధనం: దేశీ, ధనం: ధనేశ)

in_marathi.name: Yashodhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yashodhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who bestows the blessings of God

in_bengali.name: Yashodhan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's gift
in_bengali.long_meaning: Yashodhan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who bestows the blessings of God
